changelog: Film, show and episode pages now fill the whole window with artwork. New More details button under Play (credits, release, studios, video/audio/subtitle info, and audio/subtitle pickers). Previous/next episode arrows, box set progress (N of M watched), smoother page changes, bigger Edit Images dialog. New server settings on the plugin page: default accent, Home slideshow options, More details open by default. Works better with KefinTweaks (breadcrumbs, season flattening, series info) and Jellyfin Enhanced (tags on the theme's own cards); Watchlist link finds its tab on any server. Fixed a flicker when opening pages and the theme constantly re-running in the background.
description: A black Jellyfin theme that shows artwork backdrops, with an accent colour picker.
name: Crimson Noir
overview: A black Jellyfin 12 theme with artwork backdrops, an accent colour picker and rebuilt Home, detail, search, watchlist, calendar, requests and player pages. Needs the File Transformation plugin.
